title: Migrations in Entity Framework Core
description: Learn the EF Core migrations workflow for keeping database schema in sync.

data.text: Migration is a way to keep the database schema in sync with the EF Core model by preserving data. EF Core API builds the model from entity classes, Data Annotations, and Fluent API configurations.

items: **<timestamp>_<MigrationName>.cs** - Main migration file with Up() and Down() methods
**<ContextName>ModelSnapshot.cs** - Snapshot of current model for change detection

data.caption: EF Core migration workflow
data.definition:
graph TB
    A[Change Model] --> B[add-migration]
    B --> C[Migration File]
    C --> D[update-database]
    D --> E[Database Updated]

data.title: Add Migration Commands
data.code:
# Package Manager Console
add-migration InitialSchoolDB

# .NET Core CLI
dotnet ef migrations add InitialSchoolDB

data.title: Update Database Commands
data.code:
# Package Manager Console
update-database

# .NET Core CLI
dotnet ef database update

data.title: Revert Migration
data.code:
# Revert to specific migration
update-database InitialSchoolDB

# Remove last migration (if not applied)
remove-migration

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Migrations keep database schema in sync with model
data.takeaway: Continue to learn about CLI commands.
